item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
Issued at 06:53 AM 09 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NegrosOccidental(SanCarlosCity, SalvadorBenedicto), #Palawan(Dumaran, SanVicente and Roxas) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Antique(Caluya, AniniY, Hamtic), #NegrosOccidental(SanEnrique, LaCarlotaCity, Valladolid, SilayCity, Murcia), #Guimaras(Jordan, NuevaValencia), #Palawan(Agutaya, Cuyo, Magsaysay, Araceli, Taytay, ElNido, Linapacan, Culion, Busuanga, Coron), #OccidentalMindoro(Magsaysay, SanJose, Rizal and Calintaan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 17 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 17 FINAL #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 AM 08 September 2026

Light to Moderate rains was observed over #OccidentalMindoro for the past 3 hours. With this development, all RAINFALL WARNING in this area is now terminated.

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #Palawan(Araceli, Dumaran, Busuanga, Cuyo, Magsaysay and Agutaya) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Taytay, ElNido, Linapacan, Culion, Coron), #OccidentalMindoro(SanJose, Magsaysay, Rizal and Calintaan) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
